description: Diastolic blood pressure. Can include both invasive (arterial line) and non-invasive (cuff) measurements; specify in meas_site_name.
Heart rate in beats per minute (bpm), obtained from monitor, pulse oximeter, or manual palpation.
Patient’s height in centimeters, measured or recorded at admission or encounter.

Intracranial pressure (ICP), the pressure inside the cranial vault, measured directly from an invasive monitor (e.g., external ventricular drain, intraparenchymal bolt). Units: mmHg (millimeters of mercury).
Can include both invasive (arterial line) and non-invasive (cuff) measurements. Source type should be indicated in meas_site_name.

Invasive pulse pressure variation (PPV), calculated as (maximum pulse pressure − minimum pulse pressure) / mean pulse pressure × 100 over a respiratory cycle; estimated from an arterial catheter waveform; dynamic marker of fluid responsiveness. Units: % (percent).
vital_name_examples: PPV, Pulse Pressure Variation, Arterial PPV

description: Number of breaths per minute, either manually counted or obtained from a monitor.
Systolic blood pressure. Can include both invasive (arterial line) and non-invasive (cuff) measurements; specify in meas_site_name.
Peripheral oxygen saturation (%), typically measured by pulse oximetry.
Body temperature in degrees Celsius, measured via any clinical method (oral, axillary, tympanic, rectal, or core). The measurement site or device type should be indicated in meas_site_name.
Patient’s weight in kilograms, measured or recorded at admission or encounter.
